title: The Penal Code, 1860
summary: Core criminal code of Bangladesh defining offences, general exceptions, and punishments.

title: The Evidence Act, 1872
summary: Law governing admissibility, relevancy, weight, and examination of oral, documentary, and electronic evidence.

title: The Contract Act, 1872
summary: Law relating to contracts, offer, acceptance, consideration, breach, indemnity, guarantee, bailment, and agency.

title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
summary: Law relating to specific performance of contracts, recovery of possession of property, rescission, cancellation, declaratory decrees, and injunctions.

title: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
summary: Law relating to promissory notes, bills of exchange, and cheques, including cheque dishonor prosecutions under Section 138.

title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
summary: Law governing transfer of immovable property by sale, mortgage, lease, exchange, and gift.

title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
summary: Procedural framework for investigation, inquiry, bail, trial, and appeals in criminal cases.

title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
summary: Comprehensive procedural law governing civil suits, decree execution, injunctions, and appeals.

title: The Limitation Act, 1908
summary: Prescribes statutory time limits within which suits, appeals, and applications must be instituted in courts.

title: The Companies Act, 1994
summary: Incorporation, management, winding up, and governance of private and public limited companies in Bangladesh.

title: Nari O Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (নারী ও শিশু নির্যাতন দমন আইন)
summary: Specialized law providing stringent punishment including capital punishment for violence, rape, dowry deaths, and acid attacks on women and children.

title: The Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2004
summary: Establishment of the independent Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) for preventing corruption and corrupt practices.

title: Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006 (বাংলাদেশ শ্রম আইন)
summary: Comprehensive labor law governing employment terms, wages, working hours, occupational health, safety, trade unions, and industrial disputes.

title: Right to Information Act, 2009 (তথ্য অধিকার আইন)
summary: Ensures the constitutional right of citizens to obtain public information from government, statutory, and non-government organizations.

title: Cyber Security Act / Digital Security Act
summary: Law regulating cyber security, digital forensic investigations, unauthorized access to computer systems, and critical information infrastructure.

title: Family Courts Act, 2023 (পারিবারিক আদালত আইন)
summary: Re-enacted law governing family court jurisdiction over dissolution of marriage, restitution of conjugal rights, dower (mahr), maintenance, and guardianship/custody of children.
